output.summary: Add functionality to fetch and display the user's available balance on the CardSettingsPanel.
acceptance: The CardSettingsPanel should display the user's available balance when the component mounts.
The balance should be fetched from the backend using the GET /balance endpoint.
The balance should be displayed in a readable format (e.g., $1,234.56).
The balance should update in real-time if the user makes a transaction that affects their balance.
outOfScope: Modifying the CardSettingsPanel's layout or design.
Adding new features or functionality outside of the balance display.
Changing the existing endpoints or their functionality.
